_comment: Heimdall parity-conformance inventory (P2). DEFINED, not yet CI-wired. A future CI step iterates `fixtures[]`, runs each `fixture_path`, and treats nonzero exit as a parity regression. `no_fixture[]` accounts for the remaining kept/renamed/improved PARITY.md rows so coverage of observable-behavior rows is 100%. Source: PARITY.md (74 items). Each fixture maps back to its PARITY row via the `# PARITY-ROW:` header in the file.

totals.note: fixtures[] each map to a PARITY.md kept/renamed/improved row with observable behavior; no_fixture[] accounts for the remaining rows (model-gated, prose-only, net-new-without-baseline, or intentionally-dropped) so coverage is 100%.

fixtures.finding: hooks.json hardcodes /Users/rj/Downloads/superx as the CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT fallback default in 10 places (inert when CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is set; stale otherwise).

fixtures.row: audit: agent roles resolve under the live namespace (Agents table + slash namespace /superx:*->/hmd:*)
audit: bench defaults to dry-run, zero token spend (Token-surface + net-new bench command)

Command (none) -> improved(new) heimdall version/-v

Commands superx --update/--setup/--team/--auto/--resume (kept/improved) + flags --reinstall/--skip-checkpoint/--no-goal/--skills (improved-new) — routing+usage surface
fixtures.note: Live paths exec claude/tmux/git-pull; asserts the routing + usage surface only (no model/side-effects), per P2 constraints.

Gate Pre-push check-quality-gates (improved: stacked secret/selfscan/oracle/corpus) + Hook PreToolUse Bash on git push (renamed+improved)
fixtures.note: Static composition check of hooks/hooks.json; the hook is NOT executed (it would git-push) and NOT modified.

fixtures.note: Static wiring check of bin/heimdall-land (no merge executed). Behavioral both-class proof: test/land-flow.test.sh (throwaway repos, 18 asserts).

no_fixture.row: Command `superx`/`heimdall` run task end-to-end (renamed) + interactive `--agent heimdall` (renamed)
no_fixture.rationale: model-invocation: the end-to-end and interactive forms exec `claude` and require running the model. The rename surface (binary name, --agent heimdall) is covered statically by audits/agents-resolve + commands/flag-surface. The run itself is out of P2 scope (no-model rule).
dropped: flag removed; nothing to assert beyond absence. Absence of a web UI is implied by no python server (see Findings); not a kept/renamed/improved row.

behavior-only: these set a PERMISSION_FLAG passed to the `claude` launch; observing the effect requires launching the model. The flag's presence/routing is covered by commands/flag-surface (--auto) and is a launch-time argument otherwise.

net-new, prose-only: agent role definitions are markdown specs consumed by the model; their behavior is only observable by invoking the model. Presence + name resolution is covered by audits/agents-resolve (all agents/*.md enumerated).

no_fixture.row: Gates secret-scan / heimdall-selfscan / oracle-falsify / corpus / bloat-gate / parallel-gate (improved-new)
no_fixture.rationale: net-new with NO superx baseline to meet-or-beat: these are out of strict parity scope (PARITY.md marks them NET-NEW). Their WIRING into the pre-push chain IS asserted by gates/prepush-composition. Standalone behavioral fixtures for the new gates belong to a separate (non-parity) conformance track.

no_fixture.row: Hooks UserPromptSubmit parallel-gate / PreToolUse parallelism-tracker / PostToolUse corpus-capture / git pre-push (improved-new)
no_fixture.rationale: net-new, no superx baseline: not parity rows. Their presence in hooks.json is incidentally visible to the lifecycle/prepush static checks; dedicated behavioral coverage is a non-parity track.

agent-teams env is asserted by config/settings. COLORTERM/TERM only change ANSI color codes in banners/statusline — a cosmetic branch with no behavioral contract to meet-or-beat; statusline single-line render is already asserted.
covered transitively: .quality_gates by gates/quality-gates, .conflict_log by gates/conflict-reflection, add-agent by state/subcommand-set (subcommand present). No separate fixture needed.
internal libraries sourced by other bins; no standalone CLI/exit contract. Their effects (queue.jsonl, .planning state) surface through the orchestrator run, which is model-gated and out of P2 scope.

no_fixture.row: Files .planning/STATE.md / PROJECT.md / REQUIREMENTS.md / CONTEXT.md / PLAN-*/SUMMARY-* / dispatch/queue.jsonl (kept) / evals/evals.json (renamed+improved) / .setup-done marker (kept)
no_fixture.rationale: these artifacts are WRITTEN by a live orchestrator/planner run (model-gated) or at install time. No deterministic, model-free producer to drive in a fixture. detected-stack.json is the one such artifact with a model-free producer (stack-pack), and IS fixtured.
slash commands are markdown specs the model executes; behavior is model-gated. Their namespace resolution (frontmatter name -> /hmd:<name>) IS asserted statically by audits/agents-resolve.

no_fixture.row: Documented behaviors: hybrid planning / wave parallelism / question-mark protocol / model routing / continuation / acceptance-criteria gates / autonomy levels / maintainer mode / companion auto-install / project-memory CLAUDE.md / recovery
no_fixture.rationale: prose/model behaviors carried in agent+preamble text; only observable by running the model. The acceptance-criteria GATE mechanism is covered by gates/quality-gates; autonomy-level + maintainer command resolution by audits/agents-resolve; the rest are model-inference behaviors out of P2 scope.

no_fixture.row: Token surface: caveman auto-install / CAVEMAN preamble / CLAUDE.md token section / terse preamble / claude-mem / fresh-context-per-wave / banner claim
no_fixture.rationale: preamble/marketing text + companion-plugin install (network) + model-context behaviors. The bench zero-spend design law (the one mechanically checkable token-hygiene claim) IS fixtured by audits/bench-dryrun-default.

no_fixture.row: Intentionally-dropped rows: --dashboard / SUPERX_PORT / CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER / superx-ui / superx-github.json / pixel web dashboard / GitHub one-click push
no_fixture.rationale: out of scope: these are `intentionally dropped` or `findings`, not kept/renamed/improved rows. P2 targets kept/renamed/improved-with-observable rows; drops are listed here for 100% accounting only.
